visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width photo page-title banner that opens an inner page
visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-bleed background photo (about 520px tall on desktop) with a white H1 page title, centred by default or left-aligned with the left option, followed by a 19px dark red (#900f15) bar

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background image (UE fields image + imageAlt); row 2 = rich text (UE field text) with the page title as H1 and an optional subtitle paragraph
contentPattern.source: get_block_details /block-collection/hero and blocks/hero/_hero.json (model fields image, imageAlt, text)

cells: Block name plus options, e.g. Hero Banner or Hero Banner (left)

Rich text (field text):

Page title

, optional subtitle paragraph

usage.description: Page-title banner at the top of inner pages (about 17 pages on the site, e.g. Bank Holidays).

reuseGuidance: Use for any title-only photo banner that opens a page. Choose the left option where the source left-aligns the title. For a banner with copy and a CTA use hero-promo; for video backgrounds use hero-video.
